# Harry Bush (English Cricketer)

Harry Bush was an English cricketer who played first-class cricket in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

## Career Details

- **Teams:** He played for Surrey County Cricket Club
- **Playing era:** Active during the 1890s and early 1900s
- **Role:** He was primarily a right-handed batsman

## First-Class Career

Bush had a modest first-class career with Surrey, appearing in a limited number of matches. He was one of many players who represented the county during a period when Surrey was a strong force in English county cricket.

## Limited Information

I should note that Harry Bush was not among the most prominent cricketers of his era, so detailed statistical records and biographical information about him are relatively scarce compared to more celebrated players of the period.

If you're researching him specifically, resources like **CricketArchive** or **ESPNcricinfo** may have more complete statistical records from his playing days, and county cricket historical archives might contain additional biographical details.
